people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore Yahweh was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
translations.bsb: So the LORD was very angry with Israel, and He removed them from His presence. Only the tribe of Judah remained,
translations.kjv: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
translations.asv: Therefore Jehovah was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
